Presenting MOHABBAT MITT NAHI SAKTI FULL VIDEO SONG from Aatank Hi Aatank movie starring Rajinikanth, Aamir Khan, Juhi Chawla, Archana Joglekar in lead roles, released in 1995. The song is sung by KAVITA KRISHNAMURTHY and music is given by BAPPI LAHIRI music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: MOHABBAT MITT NAHI SAKTI
Singers: KAVITA KRISHNAMURTHY
Music Director: BAPPI LAHIRI
When the film was originally announced (as Aatank) it starred Sunny Deol and 'Rajnikant' in lead roles.
